name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.8.1 adds transparent menu illustrations and moves the underground pedestrian entrance above the closed terminus head. The opposite end has the scissors crossover and ordinary tramtrack tunnel connection. Both variants use two 80m platforms, 80 km/h straight station tracks and a 40 km/h crossover. Underground running and reversal, the higher crossover speed and the original entrance were confirmed by the user. The relocated entrance and end wall require a new placement and pedestrian check in the game. Existing station resource IDs, vehicle paths and speeds are preserved; saved stations are not rebuilt automatically. Menu artwork is illustrative, not screenshots. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
